title: [v1.84.0 (Release 3716) x64 STABLE] External Tools: RDP (mstsc.exe) Integration does not work at all
author: judaspriest
body_snippet:
Hello @robertpopa22 

I created an External Tool, which was pinned to the "symbol bar" - it's an RDP Connection to a Windows Server 2019, which shall be opened with mstsc.exe and integrated inside the mRemoteNG Panel. Unfortunately, this connection runs in full screen mode outside of mRemoteNG...

OS (Client) = Windows 11 25H2
MSTSC.exe = 10.0.26100.9711

OS (Server) = Windows Server 2019

External Tool looks like this:

Name: TestVM
File Name: C:\Windows\System32\mstsc.exe
Parameter: /v:servern...

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thank you for the tool definition and the log. The line "Internal Program Title: Remote desktop connection" is what showed us which window was docked.

**What we tried in our lab.** This was a Windows Server 2025 virtual machine, not your Windows 11 25H2 or mstsc 10.0.26100.9711. The target was a lab Windows server, not Server 2019. We used an external tool with your settings: `C:\Windows\System32\mstsc.exe`, `/v:<lab server>`, "Try integration" on, pressed from the toolbar. Over the next 40 s w...

notes: closed not a defect 2026-11-02: mstsc session window separate top-level; lab docked only progress dialog
